# ADR 0006 — Publish a dsh plugin-market index generated by dsh's reference generator

- Date: 2026-11-03
- Status: accepted

## Context

dsh's **Custom plugin indexes** feature lets a user add one index URL in
**Plugins → Discover**; dsh fetches it host-side (200, no redirects), validates
it with `parseMarketIndex` (`packages/util/plugin-market-index/src/index.ts` in
the dsh checkout), and installs entries through dsh-built specs — npm
`name@version` or git `git+https://…​.git#<sha>&path:/<dir>`
(`marketInstallTarget`). dsharp wants one URL that lists every plugin in this
repository. The full format/hosting research, with dsh source citations, is
`docs/research/2026-11-03-dsh-plugin-market-index.md`.

## Decision

- One index at `market/index.json`, generated by dsh's own
  `apps/plugin-market-generator` from `market/plugins.txt` (whose only source
  line is `https://github.com/ramuzes/dsharp`). The generator discovers the
  packages through `pnpm-workspace.yaml` globs, derives display fields from the
  manifests, `locale/` files, and icons, validates every entry with the real
  parser, and pins each version's source to the git commit that last touched
  that package (`publishTimestamp` = that commit's committer time).
- **Git sources only**: the packages are not npm-published, and the format has
  no tarball source type; root `*.tgz` artifacts stay gitignored.
- **`engines.dsh` omitted**: every package's `@deepseek-ai/dsh*`
  `peerDependencies` ranges are `"*"`, and the generator's documented rule
  lists no `engines.dsh` for all-`*` ranges. Install-time compatibility is
  still enforced against the real installed manifests.
- **Regeneration is manual, after changes are pushed**: run the README command,
  then commit `market/index.json`. Because versions pin per-package last-touch
  commits, regeneration only changes the entries whose packages actually
  changed.

## Alternatives rejected

- **Hand-written index/script** — re-implements the display-field, icon,
  locale, and engines rules dsh already ships; violates this repo's
  "use the highest-level interface that exists" working rule.
- **npm-publishing the four packages** — adds a release pipeline nobody asked
  for; pinned git commits already give reproducible installs.
- **Committing tarballs as artifacts** — the format cannot reference them
  (`marketInstallTarget` only emits npm/git specs) and `*.tgz` is gitignored
  for good reason.

## Consequences

- Discover serves the last regenerated index: a plugin change pushed without
  regenerating leaves users installing the previous pinned commit (still
  installable, just not newest). The regen step is part of the release habit.
- Installs clone `github.com/ramuzes/dsharp` at a pinned SHA: the repository
  must stay public, and pinned commits must be on `master` — guaranteed by
  regenerating only after push.
- Verified live on 2026-11-03 against a real background dsh host (dedicated
  `DSH_HOME` in `.scratch/market-e2e`, logs preserved): index served over
  http, browsed through the `plugin_market` tool (all entries, metadata,
  compatibility, install targets), and `dsh-workspace-env@0.2.0` installed
  end-to-end from a market entry's git target against the real GitHub
  repository; host stayed stable (`--dump-config` exit 0, no fatal lines).
